The '''first wife''' of [[Caar Damask]] was a [[Muun/Legends|Muun]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. When Caar got a new job from [[Mals Tonith]], on [[Mygeeto/Legends|Mygeeto]], he left his [[Marriage/Legends|wife]]. Over the course of their relationship, Damask and his first wife did not have any [[Youngling/Legends|children]].<ref name="Darth Plaguei" />
